description: Résultats du contrôle sanitaire de l'eau distribuée commune par commune is a dataset listed in COEUR DE FRANCE open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté de communes Coeur de France. Résultats du contrôle sanitaire de l'eau distribuée commune par commune: prélèvements et résultats des analyses réalisées dans le cadre du contrôle sanitaire réglementaire sur les unités de distribution ou les installations directement en amont, et liens entre communes et unités de distribution. Coverage: Cœur de France (Cher). The portal files it under Eau Énergie. Its keywords are eau potable, qualité. The portal shows 57 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cc-coeurdefrance-fr-portal.
